title: What Wildlife Can You See on a Sunset Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Mostly seabirds: Cory's shearwaters from spring to autumn and gulls all year. Dolphins, flying fish and turtles sometimes, whales rarely. Nothing is promised.
heroAlt: Cory's shearwaters gliding low over a calm golden sea at dusk, seen from a boat
keywords: what wildlife can you see on a sunset boat trip in Madeira

images.prompt: About twenty minutes before sunset off Madeira's south coast in late summer, photographed from the side deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy. Three large brown and white Cory's shearwaters glide low over a calm sea on stiff, straight wings, one wingtip almost touching the water, their shapes dark against golden light reflected on the surface. The coastline is a soft dark band in the distance. Only the boat's white rail at the edge of the frame, no people, natural colours, no text.
images.alt: Cory's shearwaters gliding low over a calm golden sea at dusk, seen from a boat

images.prompt: A loose group of about fifteen large brown and white seabirds resting on calm deep blue water in warm evening light off Madeira's south coast, a few taking off and running across the surface, realistic wildlife photo, no boats, no text.
images.alt: A group of shearwaters resting on the sea in warm evening light
